items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: it wasn’t Lady Gaga’s, it wasn’t 50 Cent or somebody’s.

ctx.x: If anything — and I have had a number of students over the years, some stride students who want to learn how to do that because it’s just something that’s so old that very few people do it anymore. Although there’s a wave of young players coming up right now who are fascinating for that very reason. It’s something that’s so old that they’re listening to really old scratchy recordings and saying oh this is great, and learning it from the sheet

as well. And sometimes the sheet music doesn’t capture what the live recording does, the groove, the bounce. So if I have students, and every once in a while I’ll do some clinics overseas and in colleges. And I love it. Because people are surprised at how much they know already. In other words, I remember in Australia talking to some kids and I brought them all on stage. I got there an hour and a half before the show and I said, “How many chairs can we fit on stage?” We brought all the chairs up on stage so they…
I was listening to you play “Green Dolphin Street” and I heard you play “Frankie and Johnny.”
